outcome: S100A12 concentrations in maternal, cord, and neonatal blood
Interleukin 6 (IL-6) concentrations in maternal, cord, and neonatal blood
C-reactive protein (CRP) concentrations in maternal, cord, and neonatal blood
cohort: The study included 48 mother-neonate pairs, consisting of very preterm infants and their mothers.
finding: S100A12 did not identify mothers with HCA nor very preterm infants exposed to HCA, although IL-6 and CRP were higher in maternal blood of the HCA group.
cross-section timing: At birth/early neonatal period (maternal, cord, and neonatal blood samples)
